title: Kama shabiki mpya wa F1, nilitembelea Honda RACING Gallery
label: Jumba la Honda RACING

text.Inside Suzuka Circuit, there is a place: Ndani ya Suzuka Circuit kuna sehemu inayoitwa Honda RACING Gallery.
text.Inside, cars such as F1 cars were on dis: Ndani kulikuwa na magari mbalimbali yakionyeshwa, yakiwemo magari ya F1.
text.🏎 A McLaren Honda F1 car: 🏎 Gari la F1 la McLaren Honda
text.For F1 fans, I think this Honda RACING G: Nadhani kwa mashabiki wa F1, jumba hili la Honda RACING ni mahali pa kusisimua sana.
text.But for me, and it is really frustrating: Lakini mimi sikusisimka sana, jambo ambalo linanikatisha tamaa kweli.
text.I started to like F1 around March or Apr: Nilianza kuipenda F1 mnamo Machi au Aprili 2026 hivi.
text.I went there when only 2 or 3 months had: Nilitembelea huko baada ya miezi miwili au mitatu tu tangu niwe shabiki wa F1.
Ninafahamu F1 ya miaka ya hivi karibuni tu.
text.So the displays were a little hard for m: Kwa hiyo maonyesho hayo yalikuwa magumu kidogo kwangu kuelewa.
text.I regret that if I had learned a bit mor: Ninajuta kwamba sikujifunza zaidi historia ya F1 kabla ya kwenda; huenda ningefurahia zaidi.
text.Because I am a newcomer who started liki: Kwa kuwa mimi ni mgeni ambaye nimeanza kuipenda F1 mwaka huu wa 2026.
text.I got hooked on Drive to Survive, so I w: Nilivutiwa na Drive to Survive, kwa hiyo nikaenda Suzuka Circuit
text.Suzuka Circuit is an amusement park, but: Suzuka Circuit ni bustani ya burudani, lakini wafanyakazi wanaonekana kama wahandisi
